text:
- [IRET.28.10.1] Iteration order **is** the dense-vector order: append on
  insert, last-into-hole on delete. It is a pure function of the operation
  sequence, independent of `cap`, pointer values, and platform, and is
  therefore deterministic.

idris.name: iret_28_0_1__retract
idris.note: A retraction under the reading: the memories by last-into-hole, the agenda less the fact's matches.

idris.name: iret_28_10_1__last_into
idris.note: Last-into-hole with the head removed: the last entry moves to the head.

idris.name: iret_28_10_1__swap_remove
idris.note: Dense-vector deletion as the clause pins it: the removed entry's position takes the last; every other keeps its place.

idris.name: ldet_5_9__replay_order
idris.note: The replay stamps (a1, b2) before (a1, b3): its B memory is [b2, b3].

idris.name: ldet_5_9__run_order
idris.note: Under the reading the run stamps (a1, b3) before (a1, b2): the B memory after the delete is [b3, b2].
